body: The same independent reviewer inspected the pending fix. The signed-first regression, bounded index, and HashSet membership look corrected. One remaining cross-key freshness regression is in scope: PR-41's old local WAIT is scheduled for terminal closure, while bound PR-42 has a cached local approval and no signed receipt. During the terminal forge lookup, a sync publishes a signed WAIT for PR-42. close_waits currently rechecks verified publication only for scheduled PR-41, and gate-ledger metadata does not cover the canonical review store. Pickup can still proceed on PR-42's cached absence. The pre-round implementation reselects live signed aliases after reconciliation and sees PR-42. Please verify this scenario and pin/compare a canonical review-store generation (or the relevant evidence and roster tokens) across all signed reads and final closure/admission, failing closed if it moves. Keep annotation source binding and do not take the coarse store writer lock over discovery. Add a focused regression for publication during terminal lookup, or report why an existing invariant rules it out.
subject: BUG-2629 terminal reconciliation signed evidence
